plugin.fallback.simulated_home: simulated HOME on {platform}, where it is not verified that `claude plugin` honours CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

plugin.migration.backup_failed: Could not copy settings.json ({detail}); nothing was changed.
plugin.migration.not_current: The plugin did not end up installed, enabled and at version {version} (list: {found}). settings.json is left as it was.
plugin.migration.remove_failed: The plugin is installed, but the hooks could not be removed from settings.json ({detail}): there are duplicates; `doctor` flags them and `update` removes them.
plugin.migration.step_failed: `claude plugin` failed at step {step}: {detail}. settings.json is left as it was.
plugin.migration.switch_failed: Could not save the state of the read hook ({detail}); not migrating.
plugin.migration.switch_without_data_dir: The read hook is on and this HOME has no data directory to keep its state: not migrating, so it is not switched off. Set LOCAL_DELEGATE_LOG_DIR or use --claude-delivery settings.
plugin.revert.done: Claude Code: back to the settings delivery; plugin uninstalled.
plugin.revert.restore_failed: The plugin was uninstalled, but the hooks could not be restored in settings.json ({detail}). Run `install --claude-delivery settings` again.
